findings.text: the block-continuation test still treats any indented line as part of the open block, so in a wholly indented manifest, the case the new docstring at reckon/crew/reports.py:250 says the least-indented-column rule exists to preserve, the fields are themselves indented and every field after a block-scalar one is folded into its value: parsing a "  status: complete" line, a "  tests: |" line, a four-space "    seven passed" line, a "  commits: ["cafebabe"]" line and a "  changed_paths: ["reckon/crew/reports.py"]" line returns tests equal to "seven passed\ncommits: ["cafebabe"]\nchanged_paths: ["reckon/crew/reports.py"]" with commits empty and changed_paths empty, silently dropping the promotion-visible commits field; identical at base 78897196 and at the reviewed head (probe-extra.log), so it is not a regression but it bounds the preservation the change documents, and the remedy is to continue an open block only when the line's indent exceeds manifest_indent.

justifications.durability: tests/test_manifest_nested_keys.py:30-55 fails against the base reader on all three hoisting shapes, reproduced independently through a base-revision shadow tree and matching the node's baseline logs, so a regression is caught; the least-indented-column rule introduced at reckon/crew/reports.py:265, however, has no case of its own.
justifications.evidence: the gate receipt the done-when asks for is recorded rather than claimed, since the done-when names tests/test_manifest_nested_keys.py and its prescribed four-file cohort is logged at runs/r-20260917T104804849653-a-nested-key-stays-nested/baseline-gate.log as 4 failed and 222 passed at base 78897196 and at after-gate.log as 1 failed and 225 passed at the changed reader with only the pre-existing tests/test_crew_recovery.py::test_refusal_recovery_remedy_survives_promotion remaining, and my own re-run of tests/test_manifest_nested_keys.py at the merged head 09615744 gives 7 passed with every required positive control re-derived in review-verify.log.
justifications.fit: the edited function at reckon/crew/reports.py:247-300 keeps the module's shape, the column anchor computed once before the loop and the per-line predicate otherwise unchanged, and ruff reports the same two pre-existing findings in the file at base and at head with none added.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/reports.py:265-287 accepts a text field only at the least-indented recognised manifest field's column, and my own probes of the three hoisting shapes against base 78897196 (a nested commit under an inline-valued parent, under an indented-only parent, and with no top-level value written at all) return the nested pair or a lone nested sha while the reviewed head returns the real top-level value or an empty list; the one shape that still surfaces a nested-looking sha is an all-indented manifest whose child sits at its parent's own column, which indentation carries no signal to distinguish and which is unchanged from base.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 78897196 cad0f2a5 changes exactly reckon/crew/reports.py plus docs/evidence/archive/crew-observability-truth-landed.html and docs/plans/crew-observability-truth.html, every one inside the node's four-path fence, with tests/test_manifest_nested_keys.py deliberately left untouched and neither plan-version nor plan-modified edited.
